abilities.critical_failure: The creature becomes frightened 3 and is grabbed as long as they remain frightened.
abilities.effect: The screams increase in intensity, and a torrent of phantasmal, three-fingered hands with iron claws spews from the cauldron to assail creatures in area E13. Each creature in the room must attempt a DC 23 Will save, with the following results. Kepgeda is immune to the haunt's effects, as she loves the cauldron's screams. The haunt then rolls initiative.
abilities.failure: The creature becomes frightened 2 and becomes flat-footed as long as they remain frightened.
abilities.name: Crescendo of Claws

traits.name: Emotion
traits.text: This effect alters a creature's emotions. Effects with this trait always have the mental trait as well. Creatures with special training or that have mechanical or artificial intelligence are immune to emotion effects.

traits.name: Enchantment
traits.text: Effects and magic items with this trait are associated with the enchantment school of magic, typically involving mind control, emotion alteration, and other mental effects.

traits.name: Fear
traits.text: Fear effects evoke the emotion of fear. Effects with this trait always have the mental and emotion traits as well.

traits.name: Mental
traits.text: A mental effect can alter the target's mind. It has no effect on an object or a mindless creature.

abilities.trigger: A creature other than Kepgeda is within 15 feet of the cauldron for at least 1 round

hazard.description: The cauldron's ear-splitting keening calls forth spectral claws to assail ears and souls alike.
hazard.disable: DC 22 Athletics to tip the cauldron, or DC 20 Occultism or Religion (trained) to ward against the cauldron's effects. Any combination of three successful attempts is required to fully disable the haunt. When the haunt is disabled, the coven seeks vengeance (see Coven's Vengeance)
hazard.name: Kepgeda's Keening Cauldron
hazard.reset: The haunt becomes inert (resuming its usual screaming) at the end of any round in which no creatures other than Kepgeda remain in her kitchen.
hazard.routine: The spectral hands scurry about, grabbing at all of Kepgeda's foes in area E13. Each such creature takes 3d6 mental damage (DC 20 basic Will save) as the spectral claws assail them. A creature that takes mental damage from this effect doesn't reduce their frightened value at the end of their next turn.

traits.name: Unique
traits.text: A rules element with this trait is one-of-a-kind. The DC of Recall Knowledge checks related to creatures with this trait is increased by 10.

traits.name: Complex
traits.text: A hazard with this trait takes turns in an encounter.

traits.name: Haunt
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is a spiritual echo, often of someone with a tragic death. Putting a haunt to rest often involves resolving the haunt’s unfinished business. A haunt that hasn’t been properly put to rest always returns after a time.
